description: Pure-PHP library to generate PDF documents: the modular, strictly typed successor to TCPDF. UTF-8 and RTL text, HTML/CSS rendering, SVG, images, encryption, PAdES signatures, PDF/A, PDF/X and PDF/UA.
rules: The Composer package is tecnickcom/tc-lib-pdf, the namespace is \Com\Tecnick\Pdf and the entry class is \Com\Tecnick\Pdf\Tcpdf. It requires PHP 8.2 or later.

tc-lib-pdf is not a drop-in replacement for TCPDF. The TCPDF API (new TCPDF(), AddPage(), Cell(), Write(), Output(), SetFont()) does not exist here and TCPDF documentation does not apply. Never mix the two APIs.

A document is built by inserting a font with $pdf->font->insert($pdf->pon, 'helvetica', '', 12), calling $pdf->addPage(), writing with addHTMLCell() or addTextCell(), then getOutPDFString() for the raw PDF bytes and renderPDF() to stream them.

K_PATH_FONTS must be defined and point at vendor/tecnickcom/tc-lib-pdf-font/target/fonts. The fonts are generated by the Composer post-install-cmd and post-update-cmd scripts; a K_PATH_FONTS error means they have not been generated yet.

Fonts, images, graphics, pages, filters, encryption, signatures, parsing, barcodes, colors, files and Unicode live in separate tecnickcom/tc-lib-* Composer packages that are pulled in as dependencies. Require only tecnickcom/tc-lib-pdf.
The runnable scripts under examples/ (E000 to E084, listed in examples/index.md) are the canonical usage reference. Prefer adapting them over reconstructing calls from method names.

In-depth topics have dedicated documents under doc/: FONTS.md, STANDARDS.md for PDF/A, PDF/X and PDF/UA conformance, DIGITAL_SIGNATURES.md, PDF_IMPORT.md, ICC_PROFILE.md, REMOTE_RESOURCES.md and CACHE.md.
Digital signing goes through the $pdf->signature() facade. Profiles are legacy (adbe.pkcs7.detached), pades-b-b, pades-b-t, pades-b-lt and pades-b-lta; upgradeToLta() adds the archive timestamp.
